grid_policy: Retain exactly the eight-input SVC search space, fixed settings, High weights and selection rules. Independently tune all settings/thresholds with the original inner folds using 23 existing Broad D inputs. Copy earlier eight-input SVC and RF reference scores unchanged.
validation: Original five repeats of five stratified outer folds and four stratified inner folds. Fit encoding/scaling on real training members only. Primary score >=4; 17 High/80 Below-high. No synthetic training rows, BAT predictors or new questionnaire features.
interpretation: Exploratory comparison on the same 97 people. Raw decision-function margins are uncalibrated. No clinical validation, independent cohort or deployment fit.
